title: Failure branches
kicker: Quests, failure, memory · consequence as content
loopLine: Quests and events · Farm / hunt / defend · Delve
hook: **Vision:** a lost sector, failed extract, or failed defence can open **different ground** — not only a wipe. Consequence as content. Not finished / not playable yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Not playable yet. Loss today does not reliably open new questlines or domains by this rule.
Content that starts because you failed — bandits, a domain, a quest — not only “try again.”
The dead-run end. Branches sit beside wipe, not instead of stakes.
New map pressure or places opened by loss — shared with farm / hunt / defend and delve.

alsoTrue: Ending a world still follows keep-who-you-are / lose-where-you-were — branches are not a prestige wipe of the summoner.
Named on both quests and territorial loops so it cannot hide.

sections.title: Not finished / not playable yet
paras: Do not expect every lost sector or failed run to open a curated branch today.
The design promise is consequence as content when this Vision ships.

sections.title: What it is (design)

cards.name: Lost sector
cards.body: Map failure opens bandits, pressure, or a new problem to solve.

cards.name: Failed extract
cards.body: Delve wipe can open a domain, quest, or other ground — not only emptiness.

cards.name: Failed defence
cards.body: Failed defence can open different ground as content — still beside real lose stakes (homeworld fall ends the world).

sections.note: Win/lose of a world still matter — see [new world](new-world-prestige).

sections.title: Where it hangs
paras: Quests and events name the story clock.
Farm / hunt / defend and the Delve are where the failures happen.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Play for keeps — branches do not mean failure is free.
Treat missing “new quest from wipe” prompts as Vision.
When branches ship, read them as content you unlocked the hard way.
doNote: Stop when failure ≠ only a reset button. Related: [quest log](quest-log), [delve](delve).

mixUps.q: I wiped — where is my branch?
mixUps.a: Failure branches are Vision. Absence is expected.
No. World loss drops loam and holdings; roster/souls/essence bank — see [new world](new-world-prestige).

mixUps.q: Is this soft failure with no stakes?
mixUps.a: No. Branches sit beside real loss — consequence as content, not a free retry.
No. Lost sectors and failed defences are in scope too.
